result.description: Lark is ByteDance's international workplace suite (messaging, docs, calendar, mail, approval, base, HR) with an Open Platform for building apps and bots.
result.auth_detail: Custom apps exchange app_id and app_secret for a tenant_access_token (about 2h, app identity). Store apps get app_access_token plus tenant_access_token. user_access_token comes from standard OAuth 2.0 auth-code flow for user identity. Calls carry the token as a Bearer header.
result.access_detail: Developer console signup is free and self-serve. A custom app inside your own tenant needs that tenant admin's approval of scopes and release. A store/ISV app for other tenants needs Lark open platform launch review, plus tenant admin install approval. Some scopes can be tested with the developer's user token without review. Pricing-plan restrictions not verified.
result.api_notes: Large REST surface at open.larksuite.com: IM/messaging, contacts, docs, drive, sheets, base, calendar, mail, approval, VC, tasks, HR and more. Event subscriptions via webhook or long-connection WebSocket. Official SDKs in Go, Java, Python and Node.
result.blocker: Per-tenant admin approval of scopes. Public distribution to other tenants requires Lark store app review. Region split: Feishu (China) vs Lark (international) domains.

evidence.quote: The permissions applied for by the app developer need to be reviewed by the tenant administrator.
This is the Feishu/Lark official OpenAPI MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool designed to help users quickly connect to the Feishu/Lark platform.
